children: European equity markets were set to open lower on Tuesday, extending the previous session’s losses as renewed selling in global technology and artificial intelligence stocks dampened investor sentiment.
Rising oil prices further heightened concerns over inflation and the outlook for interest rates.

Meanwhile, investors continued to monitor geopolitical risks across Europe as governments worked to contain widespread unrest over inadequate public services and the rising cost of living, which turned violent over the weekend.
European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde also warned that rising bond yields, driven by concerns over government debt, could weigh on economic growth and inflation.
In premarket trading, Euro Stoxx 50 futures fell 0.7%, while Stoxx 600 futures declined 0.5%.

title: European Stocks Poised to Open Lower
